notes.01_USB_Power: Core USB device powered by host hub; separate from OrangePi5V source. RF disabled; encoder supply only after enumeration. Verify USB budget.
notes.02_Controller: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N8. New firmware pin map; native USB serial/audio functions require implementation. External I2C ADC for left/right winding currents.
notes.03_Hardware_Interlock: Watchdog resets MCU on timeout. Downstream ACT_READY inhibits drive and servo data when actuator rail is off. E-stop auxiliary contact also requests stretched reset; fresh manual arming required.
notes.04_Drive_Encoders: External CytronMDD10A PWM/DIR control and two encoder interfaces. No motor power inside the logic connector.
notes.05_Servo: Six addressed servos on one powered DATA/V+/GND connector. No external serial adapter and no shared2.5A current limiter. Verify harness rating.
notes.06_Audio: MAX98357A integrated for4-ohm/3W speaker. Both output terminals active. Start muted; firmware volume/load tests required.
notes.07_Battery_Voltage: INA226bus-voltage only,0x40. Shuntinputs shortedGND. Motor currents use independent PWM-compatible measurement channels.
notes.09_Audio_Power: Existing separate5.077V audio buck retained to avoid spending hostUSB current budget on speaker peaks. F2 protects its input branch.
notes.10_Battery_Power: Externally fused3S input and inputTVS. Q50 feeds Cytron/servo; host and audio remain unswitched. Conductor/connector/regeneration qualification remains required.
notes.16_Orange_Pi_Power: Soldered Waveshare5Vmodule andcompact3.15ASMDinputfuse. USB-CsourceCC/attach/switch control. Never bridge host output to USBdeviceVBUS.
notes.17_Motor_Current: Separate left/right in-linebidirectional motor currents; two shunts andPWM-rejecting amplifiers. ValidateADCcalibration,transients and thermal performance.
notes.18_Actuator_Cutoff: One physical NC opens Q50 gate sink regardless of MCU command. Second NC requests MCU reset; release requires fresh manual arming. Unknown actual button terminal orientation must be verified. Single MOSFET is not redundant or safety-certified; inrush, stored energy and regeneration require bench tests.
notes.19_Fans: Two12V nominal3010 fans,common1A fuse upstream of Q50;0.2A combined assumed,not measured. Verify XH mate/polarity,voltage/startup and wire limits.
